subject: Re: Ridgeline Trucking - insurance cert came back
body: Lorrie - once you've got the on-time numbers, let's also pull Cumberland Gap Carriers and Volunteer Logistics so I can compare all three before the Q4 refresh. No rush, end of week is fine.\n\nFloyd

subject: Building materials lane to Charlotte
body: Hal - following up on the building materials you mentioned moving to Charlotte this summer. I can hold capacity on that lane if you give me a heads up a couple days out. Let me know the volume and I'll work up a rate.\n\nFloyd Whitaker, Whitaker Freight Services

subject: Douglas Lake in November
body: Darl - penciling in the Douglas Lake trip for November 7 through 9. Bring the good rods. I'll handle the cabin. Tell Mama June I'll call her this weekend.\n\nFloyd

subject: Quote - Knoxville to Columbus auto parts lane
body: Glen - worked up a rate on that Knoxville to Columbus run. I can do $1,850 all in on a dry van, two day transit, pickup ready by 8am. That holds through end of June. If the volume picks up we can talk a discount on regular weekly loads. Let me know and I'll get a carrier locked in.\n\nFloyd Whitaker, Whitaker Freight Services

subject: Re: Grain hauls into August
body: Ruth - thanks for the heads up on the August volume. I can hold capacity on the Knoxville to Memphis lane if you give me three days notice. Rate's holding steady at last month's number. I'll have Dale send over the updated rate confirmation once you give me the go ahead.\n\nFloyd

subject: Building materials to Charlotte
body: Pete - got a flatbed carrier I trust for that Charlotte building materials run. Looking at $2,100 for the load, tarped, delivery by Friday. Need the dims and weight to confirm. Holler if that works and I'll book it.\n\nFloyd Whitaker, WFS

subject: Mentorship cohort - autumn
body: Keith - let's get the autumn mentorship cohort nailed down before the TN Freight conf on Oct 10. I'm thinking eight mentees, six week run, kicking off late September. Can you take the carrier vetting session if I cover broker basics and DOT compliance? Let me know a good night this week to hash it out over a beer.\n\nFloyd

subject: Re: Reactivating your account
body: Hal - good to hear from you. I'd be glad to pick the lanes back up. Send me what you're moving and where, and I'll work up fresh rates. Things have settled down since last year and I've got solid capacity in the SE and Midwest now.\n\nFloyd Whitaker, Whitaker Freight Services

subject: Carrier vetting refresh
body: Nan - heads up, we're running our annual carrier vetting refresh through Q4. All the carriers moving your ag freight are getting their insurance and authority re-checked. No action needed on your end, just want you to know we keep the folks hauling your product fully vetted.\n\nFloyd

subject: Loads to cover this week
body: Brand - here's your list for the week. Cumberland Auto parts run needs a carrier by Tuesday, check Ridgeline first. Valley Grain has two loads Thursday. Call the carrier and confirm insurance is current before you book anything. Come find me if a rate looks off. You're doing good.\n\nDad

subject: Q2 numbers before our Oct review
body: Wayne - can you pull together the Q2 P&L when you get a chance? Want to look it over before our October 2 review. Revenue's been steady, but I want to check where we landed on the carrier vetting expenses. No rush, sometime in July is fine.\n\nFloyd

subject: Cody's homecoming weekend
body: Hon - Cody's homecoming is Oct 24, same weekend as the fall cookout we talked about pushing. Let's figure out the menu this weekend. I'm thinking ribs and pulled pork, maybe a brisket if the boys are bringing folks. Tell Megan to come up from Nashville if she can.\n\nFloyd

subject: Check in
body: Megan - how's the semester wrapping up? Your mama and I are proud of you. Let us know if you need anything for the fall. We'll get the college payment squared away like always. Come home for the cookout if you can, Oct 17. Love you.\n\nDad

subject: Men's breakfast
body: Pastor - I can bring the breakfast for the men's group next month. Thinking biscuits and gravy, maybe some smoked sausage off the pit. Just let me know the headcount and the date. Always glad to help.\n\nFloyd Whitaker

subject: RoutePoint demo follow-up
body: Travis - after the RoutePoint demo, let's list what we like versus FreightFlow Pro. I'm leaning RoutePoint, the load board integration looked cleaner. Write down anything that'd slow the team down switching over. We'll talk it through at the Monday huddle.\n\nFloyd

subject: Mama June's birthday
body: Darl - Mama June's birthday is coming up. I'll send her usual and call. You think she'd want us all up in Harlan for a weekend, or should we wait for Christmas? Let me know what Tammy and the family are thinking.\n\nFloyd

subject: DOT webinar prep
body: Bren - the next DOT compliance webinar is Oct 23. Can you get the registration link out to the client list and book the Zoom? I'll update the slides once Marcus finishes the deck. Let's aim to send the invite end of September.\n\nFloyd

subject: Capacity for next week
body: What's your availability look like next week out of Knoxville? I've got a couple auto parts loads heading to Columbus and Cincinnati. Need dry vans, pickup early in the week. Send me your current rates and I'll get them tendered over.\n\nFloyd Whitaker, Whitaker Freight Services

subject: NYE at your place
body: Keith - Donna and I are in for New Year's Eve at your place. Want me to smoke a brisket to bring? Let me know what else you need. Should be a good time as always.\n\nFloyd

subject: Poker this Thursday
body: Roy - we still on for poker Thursday at The Back Porch? Tell Junior and Eddie. I'll bring a six pack of the Pretentious. Usual time, 7 o'clock.\n\nFloyd
